TracerOneTwoPunch.name: One-Two Punch
TracerOneTwoPunch.description: Reduce the cooldown of Melee by 1 second and it gains an additional charge.

TracerPartingGift.name: Parting Gift
TracerPartingGift.description: Recall leaves behind 6 bombs that deal 240 damage each to different targets. Heroes hit with these bombs are Slowed by 50% for 0.75 seconds and grant 7% Pulse Bomb charge.

TracerTracerRounds.name: Tracer Rounds
TracerTracerRounds.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 10%. Basic Attacks against Heroes reveal a small area around them for 3 seconds.

TracerLeechingRounds.name: Leeching Rounds
TracerLeechingRounds.description: Increase the healing from Basic Attacks by up to 200%, based on the amount of health Tracer is missing.

TracerPulseGenerator.name: Pulse Generator
TracerPulseGenerator.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero heals Tracer for 12% of her maximum Health over 1.5 seconds and refunds a charge of Blink.

TracerIsThataHealthPack.name: Is That a Health Pack?!
TracerIsThataHealthPack.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe instantly heals Tracer for 15% of her maximum Health and reduces the cooldown of Healing Fountain by 15 seconds. Drinking from a Healing Fountain instantly heals for 20% of Tracer's maximum Health.

TracerSleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
TracerSleightofHand.description: Reduces Reload time by 50%. This equals 20% more damage per second.

TracerFocusFire.name: Focus Fire
TracerFocusFire.description: If an entire ammo magazine is unloaded on an enemy within 2 seconds, the last bullet will deal 80 bonus damage. This is equal to 35% of the total magazine.

TracerLockedandLoaded.name: Locked and Loaded
TracerLockedandLoaded.description: Reactivate Reload within the last 50% of its cast time to increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 40% for that magazine.

TracerStickyBomb.name: Sticky Bomb
TracerStickyBomb.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's radius by 50% and enemies hit are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

TracerQuantumSpike.name: Quantum Spike
TracerQuantumSpike.description: Pulse Bomb deals an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage to Heroes.

TracerPulseRounds.name: Pulse Rounds
TracerPulseRounds.description: Increases Pulse Bomb's range and charge rate from Basic Attacks against Heroes by 100%.

TracerUntouchable.name: Untouchable
TracerUntouchable.description: Passive: After Blinking, gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.25 seconds. Quest: Takedowns increase Tracer's Basic Attack damage by 5%, up to 25%. These bonuses are lost on death.

TracerJumper.name: Jumper
TracerJumper.description: Passive: When Blink has no charges remaining, its cooldown refreshes 100% faster. Casting Blink grants Tracer a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health for 3 seconds. This Shield stacks up to 3 times.

TracerTelefrag.name: Telefrag
TracerTelefrag.description: Passive: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Recall by 0.1875 seconds. When Tracer arrives at her Recall location she becomes Unkillable for 1 second and nearby enemies take 175 damage and are knocked back.

TracerBulletSprayMelee.name: Bullet Spray
TracerBulletSprayMelee.description: Increases the radius of Melee by 30%, and causes it to damage all enemies in range.

TracerHeavyHanded.name: Heavy Handed
TracerHeavyHanded.description: Heroes hit by Melee have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

TracerRicochetHeroWeapon.name: Ricochet
TracerRicochetHeroWeapon.description: Tracer's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to hit another nearby enemy, prioritizing Heroes.

TracerChronoTriggers.name: Chrono Triggers
TracerChronoTriggers.description: Casting Blink causes Basic Attacks to not consume ammo for 1 second.

TracerGetStuffedMelee.name: Get Stuffed!
TracerGetStuffedMelee.description: Increases Melee's Pulse Bomb charge against Heroes from 10% to 20%. Hitting an enemy with Melee who is stuck with a Pulse Bomb causes the bomb to instantly explode and knock the target away.

TracerTotalRecallRecall.name: Total Recall
TracerTotalRecallRecall.description: Recall heals Tracer equal to the amount of Health she lost during that time.

TracerCompositionBPulseBomb.name: Composition B
TracerCompositionBPulseBomb.description: Successfully sticking a Pulse Bomb to an enemy Hero also drops another one at their feet that deals 50% damage and explodes slightly earlier.
